title: 10 Best ERP Software for Businesses in 2026
content:
Businesses today need smarter ways to manage their operations, inventory, finances, and customer relationships. Choosing the best ERP software has become essential for companies looking to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and support long-term growth. Advanced ERP software combines multiple business functions into one platform, helping them automate their workflow and make faster decisions.

From manufacturers and retailers to distributors and B2B marketplaces for wholesale buyers, the right ERP solutions help streamline business operations and provide better visibility across different departments. According to Oracle What Is ERP Guide, ERP software improves inventory visibility and helps reduce surplus and overstock inventory through centralized tracking.

Here are the key points to help you quickly understand the main benefits and insights:

An ERP system brings all business processes together into one platform

  • The best ERP software helps improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
  • Cloud-based ERP tools provide better growth and flexibility.
  • Selecting the right ERP solutions depends on the size and type of business.


What is ERP Software? 
 

ERP(Enterprise Resource Planning) software is a type of software that helps businesses manage and connect important business functions in a single platform. These ERP tools integrate developments such as accounting, inventory, sales, procurement, and human resources.

In simple terms, ERP software connects separate data systems and automates workflows, helping businesses run smoothly. Companies use ERP solutions to access real-time insights, reduce manual tasks, and improve decision-making. 

For businesses managing large volumes of inventory, ERP systems offer significant benefits. Businesses involved with surplus inventory buyers, companies that buy and sell excess inventory and overstock items mostly use ERP systems to manage and track stock levels, stock movements, and overall operational efficiency.

List of 10 Best ERP Software

Below is a list of the top 10 ERP software in the world that businesses commonly use:

1. Epicor Kinetic
 

It is a cloud-based ERP solution. Key features include:

  • Manufacturing-focused ERP platform
  • Production management tools
  • Real-time analytics
  • Supply chain visibility

    Epicor Kinetic is best suited for medium- to large-sized manufacturing businesses and industrial companies that need improved production management and smoother operations.


2. NetSuite ERP
 

Key features of NetSuite ERP are:

  • Cloud-based ERP platform
  • Financial management and accounting
  • Workflow automation and customisation
  • Real-time dashboards and reporting

    It is best for small to large businesses and fast-growing companies. It is ideal for organizations looking for an all-in-one cloud ERP solution.
     

3. SAP S/4HANA
 

It is an AI-powered analytics ERP solution that helps businesses gain real-time insights, improve decision-making, and enhance operational performance. Key Features are:

  • Advanced manufacturing operations
  • Cloud and on-premise installation options
  • Financial management and management

AI and machine learning capabilities

Best suited to large enterprises and multinational companies. It is suitable for organizations with complex business operations, industries such as manufacturing, retail, utilities, and logistics.

4. Infor ClodSuite Industrial
 

This software helps businesses manage production, supply chain, inventory, and financial operations in a centralized system. Core features include:

  • Warehouse optimization
  • Cloud-based installation
  • Industry-based workflows for manufacturers
  • Financial management and costing
     

According to Gartner ERP Research, more than 60% of businesses are prioritizing cloud ERP systems for scalability and operational flexibility. This ERP solution is best for single-process and multi-process production businesses, as well as small to medium-sized manufacturing businesses.

5. DELMIAworks
 

It provides a manufacturing-focused ERP tools list with key features like:

  • Quality control tools
  • ERP+manufacturing integration
  • Real-time production monitoring
  • Inventory and warehouse management
     

It best suits small to medium-sized manufacturing companies, especially those involved in plastic, medical devices, and automotive.

6. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
 

A cloud-based ERP solution designed for small to medium-sized businesses, having the following main features:

  • Supply chain management
  • Financial management and accounting
  • Inventory control
  • Integration with Microsoft 365
  • Businesses that have multi-location and multi-currency can benefit from this software.

 

7. QAD Adaptive
 

It is commonly used in industries like consumer products, automotive, food & beverage, Life science, and high-tech manufacturing businesses. Key features are:

  • Quality management and compliance tracking
  • Global trade and multi-country support
  • Demand planning & forecasting
  • Supply chain & procurement management
     

QAD adaptive ERP tool best suits manufacturing companies with complex operations and companies managing multi-site or multi-country operations.

8. Sage X3
 

An ERP solution built  for medium to large-scale businesses with key features like:

  • Manufacturing and production control
  • Multi-company and multi-currency support
  • Cloud and on-premise installation options
  • Purchasing and procurement management
     

It is ideal for manufacturing companies, businesses with multi-location operations, and distribution businesses.

9. Odoo ERP
 

Primary features of this tool involve:

  • Accounting and financial management
  • E-commerce and website integration
  • Human resource and payroll
  • Project management
     

In Odoo ERP Platform, small and medium-sized businesses are rapidly adopting modular ERP solutions to improve operational efficiency. 

10. Workday
 

Organisations commonly use it to manage finance, human resources, and payroll, and have core features like:

  • Financial management
  • Analytics and Reporting
  • Planning and forecasting the workforce
  • Payroll and compensation
     

Large companies, universities and educational institutions, healthcare organizations, and global organizations with spread-out teams widely use it.

Benefits of Using ERP Solutions
 

Businesses adopt ERP Solutions to improve efficiency and create better visibility across various operations.

Major benefits include:

  • Better inventory management
  • Improved reporting and forecasting
  • Efficient supply chain management
  • Reduced operational cost
  • Better workflow automation
  • Centralized business data
     

As per, SAP ERP Solutions Overview, AI-powered ERP tools are helping businesses improve forecasting, automation, and real-time analytics in 2026. For companies involved with surplus stock, ERP systems help organizations working with liquidation platforms manage inventory flow more effectively and support businesses looking to buy and sell excess inventory in UAE markets.

Key Features to Look for in ERP Software 2026
 

When choosing the best ERP Software, businesses should ensure these features:

Scalability - Choose systems that support future growth.

Cloud Accessibility- Cloud ERP allows remote access and improved team coordination.

Inventory management- Strong inventory functions help businesses that buy excess inventory in Qatar, buy and sell excess inventory in the UAE, and buy excess inventory in Saudi Arabia.

Real-time analytics- It helps businesses to monitor live data instantly, helping them to make fast and accurate decisions based on current operational performance.

The global ERP software market is projected to exceed USD 70 billion by 2026 due to rising cloud adoption and digital transformation.

ERP Software and Surplus Inventory Management
 

Businesses can use ERP-driven insights along with a checklist for surplus buyers to assess suppliers, improve purchasing decisions, and check quality of surplus electrical supplies before making procurement decisions.

ERP companies also help improve forecasting, reduce waste, and optimize surplus inventory workflows across industries. As per Grand View Research ERP Market Report, the global ERP software market is projected to exceed USD 70 billion by 2026 due to rising cloud adoption and digital transformation.

FAQ
 

1. What is ERP software used for?

ERP manages core business functions like finance, HR, inventory, and supply chain operations, while also integrating data across various departments to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support better decision-making.

2. Which is the best ERP software in 2026?

Top ERP software in 20206 includes SAP, NetSuite, and Microsoft Dynamics.

3. What are ERP tools?

They are individual applications within an ERP system software that handle specific functions such as accounting, inventory management, HR, procurement, and customer management.

4. What are examples of ERP systems?

ERP system examples include SAP, Odoo, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. These systems help businesses manage key processes like finance, inventory, and supply chain operations in one integrated platform.

5. Can ERP software help manage excess inventory?

Yes, ERP software helps manage excess inventory by tracking surplus stock, supporting surplus inventory buyers, integrating with liquidation platforms, and improving visibility for businesses that buy and sell overstock products.

6. What features should businesses look for in ERP tools?

Businesses should look for ERP tools that offer automation, analytics, cloud access, scalability and strong integration with other ERP products.
